audio/en/D1/D1-U03-01_t2.mp3.text: I'm Mina. Nice to meet you.

audio/en/D1/D1-U03-02_t2.mp3.text: Yes, and Mina is my first name.

audio/en/D1/D1-U09-03_t1.mp3.text: Is this the train to Busan?

audio/en/D1/D1-U10-03_t2.mp3.text: Happy New Year to you, too!

audio/en/D1/D1-U10-05_t2.mp3.text: Congratulations! I'm so happy for you.

audio/en/D2/D2-U01-02_t1.mp3.text: Excuse me. Where is the station?

audio/en/D2/D2-U01-02_t4.mp3.text: No, it's five minutes on foot.

audio/en/D2/D2-U01-03_t1.mp3.text: Hi, I'm Jisu. What's your name?

audio/en/D2/D2-U01-03_t2.mp3.text: I'm Tom. Nice to meet you.

audio/en/D2/D2-U01-04_t2.mp3.text: Yes. How much is this shirt?

audio/en/D2/D2-U02-01_t1.mp3.text: Hi, I'm Tom. I'm new here.

audio/en/D2/D2-U02-01_t4.mp3.text: Let me know if you need help.

audio/en/D2/D2-U02-02_t4.mp3.text: It is! I really like it.

audio/en/D2/D2-U02-04_t4.mp3.text: Oh, you're a little older than me.

audio/en/D2/D2-U03-02_t3.mp3.text: How would you like it cooked?

audio/en/D2/D2-U05-01_t1.mp3.text: What do you do in your free time?

audio/en/D2/D2-U05-05_t2.mp3.text: Yes, I watch one every weekend.

audio/en/D2/D2-U06-01_t1.mp3.text: Does this bus go to the airport?

audio/en/D2/D2-U06-03_t1.mp3.text: Where can I buy a ticket?

audio/en/D2/D2-U06-04_t1.mp3.text: What time is the last train?

audio/en/D2/D2-U07-03_t4.mp3.text: Please ask him to call me.

audio/en/D2/D2-U07-05_t2.mp3.text: No, I think you have the wrong number.

audio/en/D2/D2-U08-01_t1.mp3.text: Do you have any brothers or sisters?

audio/en/D2/D2-U08-04_t2.mp3.text: Yes, this is my mom and dad.

audio/en/D2/D2-U09-01_t1.mp3.text: Are you okay? You look pale.

audio/en/D2/D2-U09-02_t1.mp3.text: I think I have a cold.

audio/en/D2/D2-U09-02_t4.mp3.text: Drink lots of water and rest.

audio/en/D2/D2-U09-03_t1.mp3.text: Do you have something for a headache?

audio/en/D2/D2-U09-03_t2.mp3.text: Yes, take this twice a day.

audio/en/D2/D2-U09-04_t1.mp3.text: I can't come to work today.

audio/en/D2/D2-U10-02_t1.mp3.text: What did you do last weekend?

audio/en/D2/D2-U10-02_t4.mp3.text: It was. I slept a lot.

audio/en/D2/D2-U10-04_t2.mp3.text: Busy. I moved to a new place.

audio/en/D3/D3-U01-01_t1.mp3.text: Welcome! Do you have a reservation?

audio/en/D3/D3-U01-01_t2.mp3.text: No, we don't. Do you have a table for two?

audio/en/D3/D3-U01-01_t3.mp3.text: Yes, please follow me. Here is the menu.

audio/en/D3/D3-U01-01_t4.mp3.text: Thank you. What do you recommend?

audio/en/D3/D3-U01-01_t5.mp3.text: Our pasta is very popular today.

audio/en/D3/D3-U01-01_t6.mp3.text: Great. I'll have the pasta, please.

audio/en/D3/D3-U01-02_t1.mp3.text: Hello. I have a reservation under Kim.

audio/en/D3/D3-U01-02_t2.mp3.text: Let me check. Yes, a room for two nights, right?

audio/en/D3/D3-U01-02_t3.mp3.text: That's correct. What time is check-out?

audio/en/D3/D3-U01-02_t4.mp3.text: Check-out is at eleven in the morning.

audio/en/D3/D3-U01-02_t6.mp3.text: Yes, it's served on the second floor from seven.

audio/en/D3/D3-U01-03_t2.mp3.text: I think so. What do you have in mind?

audio/en/D3/D3-U01-03_t5.mp3.text: Let's meet at two in front of the theater.

audio/en/D3/D3-U01-04_t3.mp3.text: Sure. Are you in a hurry?

audio/en/D3/D3-U01-04_t4.mp3.text: Yes, my flight is at six.

audio/en/D3/D3-U01-04_t5.mp3.text: Don't worry. We'll be there in thirty minutes.

audio/en/D3/D3-U01-05_t1.mp3.text: Hi. I have a headache and a sore throat.

audio/en/D3/D3-U01-05_t4.mp3.text: Take this medicine after meals, three times a day.

audio/en/D3/D3-U01-05_t5.mp3.text: Is there anything I should avoid?

audio/en/D3/D3-U01-05_t6.mp3.text: Please drink lots of water and get some rest.

audio/en/D3/D3-U02-01_t1.mp3.text: Hello. How can I help you today?

audio/en/D3/D3-U02-01_t2.mp3.text: I'd like to open a bank account.

audio/en/D3/D3-U02-01_t3.mp3.text: Sure. Do you have your ID with you?

audio/en/D3/D3-U02-01_t5.mp3.text: Thank you. Please fill out this form.

audio/en/D3/D3-U02-01_t6.mp3.text: Okay. Can I borrow a pen?

audio/en/D3/D3-U02-02_t1.mp3.text: Next, please. What can I do for you?

audio/en/D3/D3-U02-02_t2.mp3.text: I want to exchange dollars for won.

audio/en/D3/D3-U02-02_t3.mp3.text: How much would you like to exchange?

audio/en/D3/D3-U02-02_t5.mp3.text: Here you are. Please count it.

audio/en/D3/D3-U02-03_t1.mp3.text: I'd like to send this package to Canada.

audio/en/D3/D3-U02-03_t2.mp3.text: Please put it on the scale.

audio/en/D3/D3-U02-04_t1.mp3.text: I think I lost my bank card.

audio/en/D3/D3-U02-04_t2.mp3.text: I'm sorry to hear that. When did you last use it?

audio/en/D3/D3-U02-04_t4.mp3.text: I'll stop the card right away.

audio/en/D3/D3-U02-04_t5.mp3.text: Thank you. Can I get a new one?

audio/en/D3/D3-U02-04_t6.mp3.text: Yes, it will arrive in five days.

audio/en/D3/D3-U02-05_t1.mp3.text: I got a note that I missed a delivery.

audio/en/D3/D3-U02-05_t2.mp3.text: Can I see the note, please?

audio/en/D3/D3-U02-05_t4.mp3.text: Just a moment. I'll go and get it.

audio/en/D3/D3-U02-05_t5.mp3.text: Thanks. Do I need to sign anything?

audio/en/D3/D3-U03-01_t1.mp3.text: Hello. Do you have an appointment?

audio/en/D3/D3-U03-01_t2.mp3.text: No, I don't. Can I see a doctor today?

audio/en/D3/D3-U03-01_t3.mp3.text: Yes, but you'll have to wait about thirty minutes.

audio/en/D3/D3-U03-01_t5.mp3.text: Please fill out this form first.

audio/en/D3/D3-U03-02_t1.mp3.text: What seems to be the problem?

audio/en/D3/D3-U03-02_t2.mp3.text: I've had a sore throat for three days.

audio/en/D3/D3-U03-02_t3.mp3.text: Do you have a fever or a cough?

audio/en/D3/D3-U03-02_t5.mp3.text: Let me take a look. Open your mouth, please.

audio/en/D3/D3-U03-03_t3.mp3.text: No, but you need to take some medicine.

audio/en/D3/D3-U03-03_t4.mp3.text: How often should I take it?

audio/en/D3/D3-U03-03_t5.mp3.text: Three times a day, after meals.

audio/en/D3/D3-U03-04_t1.mp3.text: I hurt my ankle while running.

audio/en/D3/D3-U03-04_t4.mp3.text: Let's take an X-ray to be sure.

audio/en/D3/D3-U03-04_t6.mp3.text: I don't think so, but let's check.

audio/en/D3/D3-U03-05_t2.mp3.text: Hi, I need to change my appointment.

audio/en/D3/D3-U03-05_t4.mp3.text: It's Jinwoo Park. I have one tomorrow at ten.

audio/en/D3/D3-U04-01_t1.mp3.text: Excuse me. Do you have this jacket in a medium?

audio/en/D3/D3-U04-01_t2.mp3.text: Let me check. What color do you want?

audio/en/D3/D3-U04-01_t4.mp3.text: Here you are. The fitting room is over there.

audio/en/D3/D3-U04-02_t2.mp3.text: It's a little tight around the shoulders.

audio/en/D3/D3-U04-02_t3.mp3.text: Would you like to try a large?

audio/en/D3/D3-U04-03_t2.mp3.text: Yes, it's thirty percent off today.

audio/en/D3/D3-U04-03_t4.mp3.text: Sorry, those are new, so there's no discount.

audio/en/D3/D3-U04-03_t5.mp3.text: I see. I'll just take the shirt, then.

audio/en/D3/D3-U04-03_t6.mp3.text: Sure. I'll ring it up for you.

audio/en/D3/D3-U04-04_t1.mp3.text: I'm looking for a scarf for my mother.

audio/en/D3/D3-U04-04_t2.mp3.text: How about this silk one? It's very popular.

audio/en/D3/D3-U04-04_t3.mp3.text: It's beautiful. How much is it?

audio/en/D3/D3-U04-04_t5.mp3.text: I'll take it. Can you gift-wrap it?

audio/en/D3/D3-U04-04_t6.mp3.text: Of course. It'll take just a minute.

audio/en/D3/D3-U04-05_t1.mp3.text: Do you have these shoes in white?

audio/en/D3/D3-U04-05_t2.mp3.text: Sorry, we only have black and brown.

audio/en/D3/D3-U04-05_t3.mp3.text: Will you get white ones soon?

audio/en/D3/D3-U04-05_t5.mp3.text: Can you call me when they arrive?

audio/en/D3/D3-U04-05_t6.mp3.text: Sure. Please leave your number here.

audio/en/D3/D3-U05-01_t1.mp3.text: Excuse me. I think I'm lost.

audio/en/D3/D3-U05-01_t2.mp3.text: Where are you trying to go?

audio/en/D3/D3-U05-01_t3.mp3.text: I'm looking for the City Museum.

audio/en/D3/D3-U05-01_t4.mp3.text: Oh, it's not far. Go straight two blocks.

audio/en/D3/D3-U05-01_t6.mp3.text: Turn right. It's next to the bank.

audio/en/D3/D3-U05-02_t1.mp3.text: Can you show me where we are on this map?

audio/en/D3/D3-U05-02_t2.mp3.text: Sure. We're right here, near the park.

audio/en/D3/D3-U05-02_t3.mp3.text: How do I get to the train station?

audio/en/D3/D3-U05-02_t4.mp3.text: Take the number 10 bus from that stop.

audio/en/D3/D3-U05-03_t1.mp3.text: Is the beach within walking distance?

audio/en/D3/D3-U05-03_t2.mp3.text: Yes, it's about ten minutes on foot.

audio/en/D3/D3-U05-03_t4.mp3.text: Follow this road until you see the sea.

audio/en/D3/D3-U05-04_t1.mp3.text: Excuse me, do you know the Grand Hotel?

audio/en/D3/D3-U05-04_t2.mp3.text: Yes. It's behind that tall building.

audio/en/D3/D3-U05-04_t3.mp3.text: Can I walk there from here?

audio/en/D3/D3-U05-04_t6.mp3.text: Then go up this street and turn left.

audio/en/D3/D3-U05-05_t1.mp3.text: My phone died, and I can't find my friend's house.

audio/en/D3/D3-U05-05_t4.mp3.text: That's on the other side of the river.

audio/en/D3/D3-U05-05_t5.mp3.text: Oh no. Is there a bus?

audio/en/D3/D3-U05-05_t6.mp3.text: Yes, I'll show you the bus stop.

audio/en/D3/D3-U06-01_t1.mp3.text: Hi! Are you new in the building?

audio/en/D3/D3-U06-01_t2.mp3.text: Yes, I moved in last week.

audio/en/D3/D3-U06-01_t4.mp3.text: Nice to meet you. I'm in 405.

audio/en/D3/D3-U06-01_t5.mp3.text: Let me know if you need anything.

audio/en/D3/D3-U06-01_t6.mp3.text: Thanks. That's very kind of you.

audio/en/D3/D3-U06-02_t1.mp3.text: Excuse me. Where do I put the recycling?

audio/en/D3/D3-U06-02_t2.mp3.text: Behind the building, next to the parking lot.

audio/en/D3/D3-U06-02_t3.mp3.text: Is there a special day for it?

audio/en/D3/D3-U06-03_t1.mp3.text: Hi, I think this package is yours.

audio/en/D3/D3-U06-03_t2.mp3.text: Oh, yes! Thank you so much.

audio/en/D3/D3-U06-03_t3.mp3.text: It was in front of my door.

audio/en/D3/D3-U06-03_t4.mp3.text: The delivery person must have made a mistake.

audio/en/D3/D3-U06-03_t5.mp3.text: It happens. Have a good day!

audio/en/D3/D3-U06-04_t1.mp3.text: What a cute dog! What's his name?

audio/en/D3/D3-U06-04_t2.mp3.text: His name is Max. He's three.

audio/en/D3/D3-U06-04_t6.mp3.text: He just had a bath yesterday.

audio/en/D3/D3-U06-05_t3.mp3.text: Oh no. I live on the tenth floor.

audio/en/D3/D3-U06-05_t4.mp3.text: Me too. Let's take the stairs together.

audio/en/D3/D3-U06-05_t5.mp3.text: Good idea. It's good exercise, right?

audio/en/D3/D3-U06-05_t6.mp3.text: Ha ha, that's one way to look at it.

audio/en/D3/D3-U07-01_t1.mp3.text: Hello. Can I have a city map, please?

audio/en/D3/D3-U07-01_t2.mp3.text: Sure, here you are. It's free.

audio/en/D3/D3-U07-01_t4.mp3.text: The old castle and the night market.

audio/en/D3/D3-U07-01_t5.mp3.text: Can I walk to the castle from here?

audio/en/D3/D3-U07-01_t6.mp3.text: Yes, it takes about twenty minutes.

audio/en/D3/D3-U07-02_t1.mp3.text: Do you have any city tours?

audio/en/D3/D3-U07-02_t2.mp3.text: Yes, there's a bus tour every hour.

audio/en/D3/D3-U07-02_t5.mp3.text: Great. Two tickets for the next one, please.

audio/en/D3/D3-U07-02_t6.mp3.text: Sure. It leaves at three from the front door.

audio/en/D3/D3-U07-03_t1.mp3.text: Can you recommend a good local restaurant?

audio/en/D3/D3-U07-03_t4.mp3.text: Then try Blue Harbor. It's near the port.

audio/en/D3/D3-U07-03_t6.mp3.text: It's a good idea on weekends.

audio/en/D3/D3-U07-04_t1.mp3.text: How can I get around the city?

audio/en/D3/D3-U07-04_t2.mp3.text: I recommend buying a travel card.

audio/en/D3/D3-U07-04_t4.mp3.text: Right here. It's ten dollars for three days.

audio/en/D3/D3-U07-04_t5.mp3.text: Can I use it on the subway too?

audio/en/D3/D3-U07-04_t6.mp3.text: Yes, on buses and the subway.

audio/en/D3/D3-U07-05_t1.mp3.text: Is anything special happening this weekend?

audio/en/D3/D3-U07-05_t2.mp3.text: Yes, there's a flower festival in the park.

audio/en/D3/D3-U07-05_t3.mp3.text: That sounds lovely. Is it free?

audio/en/D3/D3-U07-05_t4.mp3.text: Yes, and there's a concert on Saturday night.

audio/en/D3/D3-U07-05_t6.mp3.text: At seven. Go early to get a good spot.

audio/en/D3/D3-U08-01_t1.mp3.text: Good morning! You must be Jiwon.

audio/en/D3/D3-U08-01_t2.mp3.text: Yes, that's right. Nice to meet you.

audio/en/D3/D3-U08-01_t3.mp3.text: I'm Paul, your team leader. Let me show you your desk.

audio/en/D3/D3-U08-01_t5.mp3.text: Here it is. Your computer is already set up.

audio/en/D3/D3-U08-02_t1.mp3.text: Let me give you a quick tour.

audio/en/D3/D3-U08-02_t3.mp3.text: This is the meeting room, and the kitchen is over there.

audio/en/D3/D3-U08-03_t1.mp3.text: Do you want to have lunch with us?

audio/en/D3/D3-U08-03_t2.mp3.text: I'd love to. Where do you usually go?

audio/en/D3/D3-U08-03_t3.mp3.text: There's a good noodle place nearby.

audio/en/D3/D3-U08-03_t5.mp3.text: Around twelve. I'll come get you.

audio/en/D3/D3-U08-04_t1.mp3.text: Today, I'd like you to read these documents.

audio/en/D3/D3-U08-04_t5.mp3.text: Yes, and write down any questions.

audio/en/D3/D3-U08-05_t2.mp3.text: It was busy, but everyone was very kind.

audio/en/D3/D3-U08-05_t3.mp3.text: Glad to hear that. Any questions?

audio/en/D3/D3-U08-05_t4.mp3.text: What time should I come in tomorrow?

audio/en/D3/D3-U09-01_t1.mp3.text: I'm having a birthday party on Saturday. Can you come?

audio/en/D3/D3-U09-02_t1.mp3.text: We're having a barbecue on Sunday. Want to join?

audio/en/D3/D3-U09-02_t2.mp3.text: I'd love to, but I have plans.

audio/en/D3/D3-U09-03_t2.mp3.text: Thanks for inviting me. This is for you.

audio/en/D3/D3-U09-03_t3.mp3.text: Oh, you didn't have to! Thank you.

audio/en/D3/D3-U09-03_t4.mp3.text: Your new place is really nice.

audio/en/D3/D3-U09-03_t5.mp3.text: Thanks. Let me show you around.

audio/en/D3/D3-U09-04_t1.mp3.text: Hi, I don't think we've met. I'm Sam.

audio/en/D3/D3-U09-04_t2.mp3.text: Hi, Sam. I'm Hana. I'm Jenny's coworker.

audio/en/D3/D3-U09-04_t3.mp3.text: Oh, nice. I'm Jenny's college friend.

audio/en/D3/D3-U09-04_t4.mp3.text: How long have you known her?

audio/en/D3/D3-U09-05_t2.mp3.text: Thank you for having me. I had a great time.

audio/en/D3/D3-U09-05_t3.mp3.text: Let me call you a taxi.

audio/en/D3/D3-U09-05_t4.mp3.text: That's okay. I'll take the subway.

audio/en/D3/D3-U09-05_t5.mp3.text: Text me when you get home.

audio/en/D3/D3-U10-01_t2.mp3.text: Hi, I'd like to make an appointment for a haircut.

audio/en/D3/D3-U10-01_t3.mp3.text: Sure. When would you like to come in?

audio/en/D3/D3-U10-02_t5.mp3.text: Do you want to keep the bangs?

audio/en/D3/D3-U10-02_t6.mp3.text: Yes, but make them a little shorter.

audio/en/D3/D3-U10-03_t1.mp3.text: I want my hair like this picture.

audio/en/D3/D3-U10-03_t3.mp3.text: Do you think it will look good on me?

audio/en/D3/D3-U10-03_t4.mp3.text: Yes, I think it will suit you.

audio/en/D3/D3-U10-04_t1.mp3.text: I'd like to dye my hair.

audio/en/D3/D3-U10-04_t2.mp3.text: What color are you thinking of?

audio/en/D3/D3-U10-05_t1.mp3.text: All done. What do you think?

audio/en/D3/D3-U10-05_t4.mp3.text: Thank you. How much is it?

audio/en/D4/D4-U01-01_t1.mp3.text: Thank you for coming in today. Please have a seat.

audio/en/D4/D4-U01-01_t3.mp3.text: Could you tell me a little about yourself?

audio/en/D4/D4-U01-01_t4.mp3.text: Sure. I have three years of experience in marketing.

audio/en/D4/D4-U01-01_t5.mp3.text: Why do you want to work for our company?

audio/en/D4/D4-U01-01_t6.mp3.text: I admire your products, and I want to grow with your team.

audio/en/D4/D4-U01-01_t7.mp3.text: What would you say is your biggest strength?

audio/en/D4/D4-U01-01_t8.mp3.text: I'm a quick learner, and I work well with others.

audio/en/D4/D4-U01-02_t1.mp3.text: Hello. How can I help you?

audio/en/D4/D4-U01-02_t2.mp3.text: I bought this jacket yesterday, but it's too small.

audio/en/D4/D4-U01-02_t3.mp3.text: I'm sorry to hear that. Do you have the receipt?

audio/en/D4/D4-U01-02_t5.mp3.text: Would you like to exchange it or get a refund?

audio/en/D4/D4-U01-02_t6.mp3.text: Can I exchange it for a bigger size?

audio/en/D4/D4-U01-02_t7.mp3.text: Of course. Let me check if we have one in stock.

audio/en/D4/D4-U01-02_t8.mp3.text: Thank you. I appreciate your help.

audio/en/D4/D4-U01-03_t1.mp3.text: Excuse me. I can't find my gate.

audio/en/D4/D4-U01-03_t2.mp3.text: May I see your boarding pass?

audio/en/D4/D4-U01-03_t4.mp3.text: You're going to gate twenty-two. It's on the second floor.

audio/en/D4/D4-U01-03_t5.mp3.text: How long does it take to get there?

audio/en/D4/D4-U01-03_t6.mp3.text: About ten minutes on foot. Take the escalator on your right.

audio/en/D4/D4-U01-03_t7.mp3.text: Thanks. Does the flight leave on time?

audio/en/D4/D4-U01-03_t8.mp3.text: Yes, boarding starts in thirty minutes.

audio/en/D4/D4-U01-04_t1.mp3.text: Did you watch the new movie yesterday?

audio/en/D4/D4-U01-04_t2.mp3.text: Yes, I did. I thought it was really exciting.

audio/en/D4/D4-U01-04_t3.mp3.text: Really? I heard the ending was a bit disappointing.

audio/en/D4/D4-U01-04_t4.mp3.text: Well, it was unexpected, but I liked it.

audio/en/D4/D4-U01-04_t6.mp3.text: The music was amazing, and the actors were great.

audio/en/D4/D4-U01-04_t7.mp3.text: Maybe I should watch it this weekend.

audio/en/D4/D4-U01-04_t8.mp3.text: You should. I'm sure you'll enjoy it.

audio/en/D4/D4-U01-05_t1.mp3.text: Hello, thank you for calling Tasty Pizza.

audio/en/D4/D4-U01-05_t2.mp3.text: Hi. I'd like to order a large pepperoni pizza for delivery.

audio/en/D4/D4-U01-05_t3.mp3.text: Sure. Would you like anything to drink?

audio/en/D4/D4-U01-05_t4.mp3.text: Yes, two bottles of cola, please.

audio/en/D4/D4-U01-05_t7.mp3.text: Your total is twenty-five dollars. It'll arrive in thirty minutes.

audio/en/D4/D4-U01-05_t8.mp3.text: Great. Can I pay by card when it arrives?

audio/en/D4/D4-U02-01_t1.mp3.text: Hello, front desk. How can I help you?

audio/en/D4/D4-U02-01_t2.mp3.text: Hi, I'm in room 512. The air conditioner isn't working.

audio/en/D4/D4-U02-01_t3.mp3.text: I'm very sorry about that. I'll send someone right away.

audio/en/D4/D4-U02-01_t4.mp3.text: Thanks. It's really hot in here.

audio/en/D4/D4-U02-01_t5.mp3.text: If it can't be fixed quickly, we can give you another room.

audio/en/D4/D4-U02-01_t7.mp3.text: Again, we apologize for the trouble.

audio/en/D4/D4-U02-01_t8.mp3.text: That's okay. Thanks for your help.

audio/en/D4/D4-U02-02_t1.mp3.text: Good morning. Can I ask for a late checkout?

audio/en/D4/D4-U02-02_t2.mp3.text: What time would you like to leave?

audio/en/D4/D4-U02-02_t3.mp3.text: Around two o'clock. My flight is in the evening.

audio/en/D4/D4-U02-02_t4.mp3.text: Let me check. Yes, two o'clock is fine.

audio/en/D4/D4-U02-02_t8.mp3.text: You're welcome. Enjoy your last day.

audio/en/D4/D4-U02-03_t1.mp3.text: Excuse me. I've already checked out.

audio/en/D4/D4-U02-03_t2.mp3.text: Yes, how can I help you?

audio/en/D4/D4-U02-03_t3.mp3.text: Could you keep my luggage until five?

audio/en/D4/D4-U02-03_t4.mp3.text: Of course. How many bags do you have?

audio/en/D4/D4-U02-03_t6.mp3.text: Here's your ticket. Please show it when you come back.

audio/en/D4/D4-U02-03_t7.mp3.text: Great. Is there a good place for lunch nearby?

audio/en/D4/D4-U02-03_t8.mp3.text: Yes, there's a nice cafe across the street.

audio/en/D4/D4-U02-04_t2.mp3.text: Yes, this is the front desk.

audio/en/D4/D4-U02-04_t3.mp3.text: The people next door are being very loud.

audio/en/D4/D4-U02-04_t4.mp3.text: I'm sorry. Which room are you in?

audio/en/D4/D4-U02-04_t5.mp3.text: Room 708. It's almost midnight, and I can't sleep.

audio/en/D4/D4-U02-04_t6.mp3.text: I'll call them and ask them to be quiet.

audio/en/D4/D4-U02-04_t7.mp3.text: Thank you. I have an early meeting tomorrow.

audio/en/D4/D4-U02-04_t8.mp3.text: I understand. Please call again if it continues.

audio/en/D4/D4-U02-05_t1.mp3.text: Hi, I have a reservation under Lee.

audio/en/D4/D4-U02-05_t2.mp3.text: Let me see. I'm sorry, I can't find it.

audio/en/D4/D4-U02-05_t3.mp3.text: Really? I booked it online last week.

audio/en/D4/D4-U02-05_t4.mp3.text: Do you have a confirmation email?

audio/en/D4/D4-U02-05_t5.mp3.text: Yes, here it is on my phone.

audio/en/D4/D4-U02-05_t6.mp3.text: Ah, I see. It was under your first name.

audio/en/D4/D4-U02-05_t8.mp3.text: Here's your key. You're in room 302.

audio/en/D4/D4-U03-01_t1.mp3.text: Hey, can we talk for a minute?

audio/en/D4/D4-U03-01_t3.mp3.text: The dishes have been in the sink for two days.

audio/en/D4/D4-U03-01_t4.mp3.text: Oh, sorry. I've been really busy this week.

audio/en/D4/D4-U03-01_t5.mp3.text: I understand, but it's starting to smell.

audio/en/D4/D4-U03-01_t6.mp3.text: You're right. I'll do them tonight.

audio/en/D4/D4-U03-01_t7.mp3.text: Thanks. Maybe we should make a schedule.

audio/en/D4/D4-U03-02_t2.mp3.text: Okay. I can clean the bathroom.

audio/en/D4/D4-U03-02_t3.mp3.text: Great. Then I'll do the kitchen.

audio/en/D4/D4-U03-02_t7.mp3.text: Whoever sees it's full takes it out.

audio/en/D4/D4-U03-03_t1.mp3.text: We're out of milk and eggs again.

audio/en/D4/D4-U03-03_t2.mp3.text: I can go to the store after work.

audio/en/D4/D4-U03-03_t3.mp3.text: Thanks. Can you get some rice, too?

audio/en/D4/D4-U03-03_t5.mp3.text: Maybe some fruit. Apples or bananas.

audio/en/D4/D4-U03-03_t6.mp3.text: Okay. Let's split the cost like always.

audio/en/D4/D4-U03-03_t7.mp3.text: Of course. Just send me the receipt.

audio/en/D4/D4-U03-04_t1.mp3.text: Is it okay if my friends come over on Friday?

audio/en/D4/D4-U03-04_t3.mp3.text: Just three. We'll watch a soccer game.

audio/en/D4/D4-U03-04_t4.mp3.text: That's fine. But I have an exam on Saturday.

audio/en/D4/D4-U03-04_t7.mp3.text: No problem. They'll leave before then.

audio/en/D4/D4-U03-05_t1.mp3.text: Did you see the heating bill this month?

audio/en/D4/D4-U03-05_t2.mp3.text: Yes. It's much higher than last month.

audio/en/D4/D4-U03-05_t3.mp3.text: I think we leave the heater on too long.

audio/en/D4/D4-U03-05_t4.mp3.text: You're right. I sometimes forget to turn it off.

audio/en/D4/D4-U03-05_t5.mp3.text: Let's turn it off when we go out.

audio/en/D4/D4-U03-05_t6.mp3.text: And maybe wear warmer clothes at home?

audio/en/D4/D4-U03-05_t7.mp3.text: Good idea. Let's try that this month.

audio/en/D4/D4-U03-05_t8.mp3.text: Okay. Let's see if it helps.

audio/en/D4/D4-U04-01_t1.mp3.text: Do you have time for a meeting this week?

audio/en/D4/D4-U04-01_t2.mp3.text: Let me check my schedule. How about Wednesday?

audio/en/D4/D4-U04-01_t3.mp3.text: Wednesday morning is difficult for me.

audio/en/D4/D4-U04-01_t6.mp3.text: Great. I'll book a meeting room.

audio/en/D4/D4-U04-01_t7.mp3.text: Thanks. I'll send you the documents before then.

audio/en/D4/D4-U04-01_t8.mp3.text: Sounds good. See you on Wednesday.

audio/en/D4/D4-U04-02_t1.mp3.text: I'm sorry, but I need to move our meeting.

audio/en/D4/D4-U04-02_t3.mp3.text: I have to visit a client tomorrow morning.

audio/en/D4/D4-U04-02_t4.mp3.text: I see. When are you free?

audio/en/D4/D4-U04-02_t5.mp3.text: Is Thursday at ten okay for you?

audio/en/D4/D4-U04-02_t8.mp3.text: Not at all. Good luck with the client.

audio/en/D4/D4-U04-03_t1.mp3.text: Can we have the meeting online instead?

audio/en/D4/D4-U04-03_t2.mp3.text: Sure. Are you working from home today?

audio/en/D4/D4-U04-03_t3.mp3.text: Yes, my son is sick, so I'm staying home.

audio/en/D4/D4-U04-03_t4.mp3.text: I'm sorry to hear that. I'll send you a link.

audio/en/D4/D4-U04-03_t5.mp3.text: Thanks. Should I turn on my camera?

audio/en/D4/D4-U04-03_t7.mp3.text: Okay. I'll join five minutes early to test it.

audio/en/D4/D4-U04-04_t1.mp3.text: The meeting is scheduled for one hour.

audio/en/D4/D4-U04-04_t2.mp3.text: Do you think we need that much time?

audio/en/D4/D4-U04-04_t3.mp3.text: Not really. Thirty minutes should be enough.

audio/en/D4/D4-U04-04_t5.mp3.text: Could you prepare the sales numbers?

audio/en/D4/D4-U04-04_t7.mp3.text: Just a simple table is fine.

audio/en/D4/D4-U04-04_t8.mp3.text: Got it. I'll have it ready.

audio/en/D4/D4-U04-05_t1.mp3.text: We need to find a time for the whole team.

audio/en/D4/D4-U04-05_t2.mp3.text: That's not easy. Everyone is so busy.

audio/en/D4/D4-U04-05_t3.mp3.text: Let's send a quick online survey.

audio/en/D4/D4-U04-05_t4.mp3.text: Good idea. How many options should we give?

audio/en/D4/D4-U04-05_t6.mp3.text: Okay. I'll make it and share it today.

audio/en/D4/D4-U04-05_t7.mp3.text: Please ask them to answer by Friday.

audio/en/D4/D4-U05-01_t1.mp3.text: Hi, I'm interested in joining the gym.

audio/en/D4/D4-U05-01_t2.mp3.text: Great! Would you like a monthly or yearly membership?

audio/en/D4/D4-U05-01_t4.mp3.text: Fifty dollars a month, or five hundred for a year.

audio/en/D4/D4-U05-01_t6.mp3.text: Sure. You can have a free one-day pass.

audio/en/D4/D4-U05-02_t3.mp3.text: I want to lose weight and get stronger.

audio/en/D4/D4-U05-02_t4.mp3.text: Our trainers can make a plan just for you.

audio/en/D4/D4-U05-02_t6.mp3.text: At least three times a week.

audio/en/D4/D4-U05-02_t7.mp3.text: That sounds hard, but I'll try.

audio/en/D4/D4-U05-03_t1.mp3.text: Excuse me. How do I use this machine?

audio/en/D4/D4-U05-03_t2.mp3.text: First, adjust the seat to your height.

audio/en/D4/D4-U05-03_t4.mp3.text: Yes. Now hold the handles and push slowly.

audio/en/D4/D4-U05-03_t5.mp3.text: How many times should I do it?

audio/en/D4/D4-U05-03_t8.mp3.text: Anytime. Don't make it too heavy at first.

audio/en/D4/D4-U05-04_t1.mp3.text: What group classes do you have?

audio/en/D4/D4-U05-04_t2.mp3.text: We have yoga, spinning, and dance classes.

audio/en/D4/D4-U05-04_t4.mp3.text: Every morning at seven and evening at eight.

audio/en/D4/D4-U05-04_t5.mp3.text: Do I need to book in advance?

audio/en/D4/D4-U05-04_t6.mp3.text: Yes, you can book on our app.

audio/en/D4/D4-U05-04_t7.mp3.text: Is it included in the membership?

audio/en/D4/D4-U05-04_t8.mp3.text: Yes, all classes are free for members.

audio/en/D4/D4-U05-05_t1.mp3.text: I'm going abroad for a month.

audio/en/D4/D4-U05-05_t2.mp3.text: Would you like to pause your membership?

audio/en/D4/D4-U05-05_t4.mp3.text: Yes, you can pause it for up to two months.

audio/en/D4/D4-U05-05_t7.mp3.text: Then please pause it from next Monday.

audio/en/D4/D4-U06-01_t1.mp3.text: Where should we go for our summer trip?

audio/en/D4/D4-U06-01_t2.mp3.text: How about the beach? I want to swim.

audio/en/D4/D4-U06-01_t3.mp3.text: Hmm, I'd rather go to the mountains. It's cooler.

audio/en/D4/D4-U06-01_t4.mp3.text: What about a place with both?

audio/en/D4/D4-U06-01_t6.mp3.text: Exactly! We can hike and go to the beach.

audio/en/D4/D4-U06-01_t7.mp3.text: Perfect. Let's look for a place to stay.

audio/en/D4/D4-U06-02_t1.mp3.text: How much should we spend on this trip?

audio/en/D4/D4-U06-02_t3.mp3.text: That sounds good. What about hotels?

audio/en/D4/D4-U06-02_t4.mp3.text: Let's find something cheap but clean.

audio/en/D4/D4-U06-02_t5.mp3.text: Should we eat at restaurants every day?

audio/en/D4/D4-U06-02_t6.mp3.text: Let's cook breakfast and eat out for dinner.

audio/en/D4/D4-U06-02_t7.mp3.text: Good plan. That will save money.

audio/en/D4/D4-U06-02_t8.mp3.text: And we can spend more on activities.

audio/en/D4/D4-U06-03_t1.mp3.text: Should we drive or take the train?

audio/en/D4/D4-U06-03_t2.mp3.text: The train is faster and more comfortable.

audio/en/D4/D4-U06-03_t3.mp3.text: But we need a car to move around there.

audio/en/D4/D4-U06-03_t4.mp3.text: We could rent a car at the station.

audio/en/D4/D4-U06-03_t6.mp3.text: I'll book the train tickets now.

audio/en/D4/D4-U06-03_t7.mp3.text: Get seats by the window, please.

audio/en/D4/D4-U06-04_t1.mp3.text: How many days should we stay in Paris?

audio/en/D4/D4-U06-04_t2.mp3.text: I think three days is enough.

audio/en/D4/D4-U06-04_t3.mp3.text: What do you want to see the most?

audio/en/D4/D4-U06-04_t4.mp3.text: The Eiffel Tower and the museums.

audio/en/D4/D4-U06-04_t5.mp3.text: Let's visit the museums in the morning.

audio/en/D4/D4-U06-04_t8.mp3.text: Smart. Then we can see the tower at night.

audio/en/D4/D4-U06-05_t1.mp3.text: What should I pack for the trip?

audio/en/D4/D4-U06-05_t2.mp3.text: It might rain, so bring a jacket.

audio/en/D4/D4-U06-05_t4.mp3.text: Comfortable walking shoes. We'll walk a lot.

audio/en/D4/D4-U06-05_t6.mp3.text: No, it's a vacation! Leave work at home.

audio/en/D4/D4-U07-01_t1.mp3.text: Hello, I'm calling about my washing machine.

audio/en/D4/D4-U07-01_t2.mp3.text: What seems to be the problem?

audio/en/D4/D4-U07-01_t3.mp3.text: It stops in the middle and won't drain the water.

audio/en/D4/D4-U07-01_t6.mp3.text: It's still under warranty. We can send a technician.

audio/en/D4/D4-U07-02_t1.mp3.text: Hi, this is Mina in apartment 4B.

audio/en/D4/D4-U07-02_t2.mp3.text: Hi, Mina. What can I do for you?

audio/en/D4/D4-U07-02_t3.mp3.text: There's water leaking from my bathroom ceiling.

audio/en/D4/D4-U07-02_t4.mp3.text: Oh no. Is it a lot of water?

audio/en/D4/D4-U07-02_t5.mp3.text: It's dripping slowly, but it's getting worse.

audio/en/D4/D4-U07-02_t6.mp3.text: It might be from the apartment upstairs. I'll check it now.

audio/en/D4/D4-U07-02_t7.mp3.text: Thank you. Should I put a bucket under it?

audio/en/D4/D4-U07-02_t8.mp3.text: Yes, please. I'll be there in twenty minutes.

audio/en/D4/D4-U07-03_t1.mp3.text: I dropped my phone, and the screen cracked.

audio/en/D4/D4-U07-03_t2.mp3.text: Let me take a look. Does the touch screen still work?

audio/en/D4/D4-U07-03_t3.mp3.text: Yes, but some parts don't work well.

audio/en/D4/D4-U07-03_t4.mp3.text: We need to replace the screen.

audio/en/D4/D4-U07-03_t6.mp3.text: About one hundred and fifty dollars.

audio/en/D4/D4-U07-03_t8.mp3.text: About an hour. You can wait here or come back later.

audio/en/D4/D4-U07-04_t2.mp3.text: I'm sorry about that. Have you tried restarting the router?

audio/en/D4/D4-U07-04_t3.mp3.text: Yes, twice, but it didn't help.

audio/en/D4/D4-U07-04_t4.mp3.text: Let me check your line from here.

audio/en/D4/D4-U07-04_t6.mp3.text: It looks like there's a problem with the cable.

audio/en/D4/D4-U07-04_t8.mp3.text: A technician can visit this afternoon.

audio/en/D4/D4-U07-05_t1.mp3.text: Hi, can you fix my bike?

audio/en/D4/D4-U07-05_t3.mp3.text: The brakes don't work very well.

audio/en/D4/D4-U07-05_t4.mp3.text: Let me see. The brake pads are worn out.

audio/en/D4/D4-U07-05_t6.mp3.text: Yes. It'll take about thirty minutes.

audio/en/D4/D4-U07-05_t7.mp3.text: Could you check the tires, too?

audio/en/D4/D4-U08-01_t1.mp3.text: What should I get my mom for her birthday?

audio/en/D4/D4-U08-01_t4.mp3.text: How about some nice gardening gloves?

audio/en/D4/D4-U08-01_t5.mp3.text: Hmm, that's a little too simple.

audio/en/D4/D4-U08-01_t6.mp3.text: Then how about a cooking class together?

audio/en/D4/D4-U08-01_t7.mp3.text: Oh, I love that idea! We can spend time together.

audio/en/D4/D4-U08-01_t8.mp3.text: Exactly. Experiences are better than things.

audio/en/D4/D4-U08-02_t1.mp3.text: Jenny is leaving the company next week.

audio/en/D4/D4-U08-02_t2.mp3.text: Really? We should get her a gift.

audio/en/D4/D4-U08-02_t3.mp3.text: Let's collect money from the team.

audio/en/D4/D4-U08-02_t4.mp3.text: Good idea. What should we buy?

audio/en/D4/D4-U08-02_t5.mp3.text: She just moved, so maybe something for her home.

audio/en/D4/D4-U08-02_t6.mp3.text: How about a nice coffee machine?

audio/en/D4/D4-U08-02_t7.mp3.text: Perfect. She drinks coffee all day.

audio/en/D4/D4-U08-02_t8.mp3.text: I'll send a message to the team.

audio/en/D4/D4-U08-03_t1.mp3.text: I'm looking for a gift for my boyfriend.

audio/en/D4/D4-U08-03_t4.mp3.text: How about a watch? These are very popular.

audio/en/D4/D4-U08-03_t5.mp3.text: They look nice, but they're a bit expensive.

audio/en/D4/D4-U08-03_t6.mp3.text: Then how about a leather wallet?

audio/en/D4/D4-U08-03_t7.mp3.text: That's perfect. His wallet is very old.

audio/en/D4/D4-U08-03_t8.mp3.text: Would you like his initials on it?

audio/en/D4/D4-U08-04_t1.mp3.text: My sister just had a baby.

audio/en/D4/D4-U08-04_t3.mp3.text: Thanks! I want to buy a gift for the baby.

audio/en/D4/D4-U08-04_t6.mp3.text: Then buy them in a bigger size.

audio/en/D4/D4-U08-04_t7.mp3.text: Good idea. Maybe for six months old.

audio/en/D4/D4-U08-04_t8.mp3.text: And add a soft toy, too.

audio/en/D4/D4-U08-05_t1.mp3.text: My friend gave me this sweater, but it's too small.

audio/en/D4/D4-U08-05_t4.mp3.text: That's okay. We can exchange it for another size.

audio/en/D4/D4-U08-05_t5.mp3.text: Great. Do you have it in a large?

audio/en/D4/D4-U08-05_t6.mp3.text: Let me check. Yes, here it is.

audio/en/D4/D4-U08-05_t8.mp3.text: Of course. The fitting room is over there.

audio/en/D4/D4-U09-01_t1.mp3.text: Hello, I need help with moving next month.

audio/en/D4/D4-U09-01_t2.mp3.text: Sure. When exactly are you moving?

audio/en/D4/D4-U09-01_t6.mp3.text: Do you need packing service, too?

audio/en/D4/D4-U09-01_t7.mp3.text: Yes, please. I'm very busy at work.

audio/en/D4/D4-U09-01_t8.mp3.text: Okay. I'll send you a price by email today.

audio/en/D4/D4-U09-02_t1.mp3.text: Hi, I'm here to see the apartment.

audio/en/D4/D4-U09-02_t2.mp3.text: Welcome. Come in and look around.

audio/en/D4/D4-U09-02_t3.mp3.text: It's bright. Which way do the windows face?

audio/en/D4/D4-U09-02_t4.mp3.text: South, so you get sunshine all day.

audio/en/D4/D4-U09-02_t5.mp3.text: How far is the subway station?

audio/en/D4/D4-U09-02_t8.mp3.text: Yes, you get one parking space.

audio/en/D4/D4-U09-03_t1.mp3.text: We have too much stuff to move.

audio/en/D4/D4-U09-03_t2.mp3.text: Let's throw away things we don't use.

audio/en/D4/D4-U09-03_t4.mp3.text: We can donate them to the library.

audio/en/D4/D4-U09-03_t6.mp3.text: If you haven't worn them in a year, give them away.

audio/en/D4/D4-U09-03_t8.mp3.text: Moving is a good chance to start fresh.

audio/en/D4/D4-U09-04_t1.mp3.text: I'm moving next week. Do I need to do anything here?

audio/en/D4/D4-U09-04_t2.mp3.text: Yes, you should change your address.

audio/en/D4/D4-U09-04_t4.mp3.text: Sure. Please fill out this form.

audio/en/D4/D4-U09-04_t5.mp3.text: Do I need my new rental contract?

audio/en/D4/D4-U09-05_t1.mp3.text: Thanks for helping me move today.

audio/en/D4/D4-U09-05_t2.mp3.text: No problem. Where should I put this box?

audio/en/D4/D4-U09-05_t4.mp3.text: It's really heavy. What's in it?

audio/en/D4/D4-U09-05_t6.mp3.text: Okay. Let's take a break after this.

audio/en/D4/D4-U09-05_t7.mp3.text: Sure. I'll order some food for us.

audio/en/D4/D4-U10-01_t1.mp3.text: Hi, is this the book club?

audio/en/D4/D4-U10-01_t3.mp3.text: Yes, I saw your post online.

audio/en/D4/D4-U10-01_t4.mp3.text: Great. We meet every other Thursday.

audio/en/D4/D4-U10-01_t6.mp3.text: A mystery novel. I'll lend you a copy.

audio/en/D4/D4-U10-01_t7.mp3.text: Thanks. Do I have to finish it by next time?

audio/en/D4/D4-U10-01_t8.mp3.text: Try your best, but it's okay if you don't.

audio/en/D4/D4-U10-02_t1.mp3.text: I heard you play soccer on weekends.

audio/en/D4/D4-U10-02_t2.mp3.text: Yes, I'm in a local team. Do you want to join?

audio/en/D4/D4-U10-02_t3.mp3.text: I'd love to, but I'm not very good.

audio/en/D4/D4-U10-02_t4.mp3.text: That's okay. It's just for fun.

audio/en/D4/D4-U10-03_t1.mp3.text: Is there still space in the cooking class?

audio/en/D4/D4-U10-03_t2.mp3.text: Yes, we have two spots left.

audio/en/D4/D4-U10-03_t3.mp3.text: What do you cook in the class?

audio/en/D4/D4-U10-03_t4.mp3.text: Different food every week. This week is Thai food.

audio/en/D4/D4-U10-03_t5.mp3.text: Sounds fun. Do I need to bring ingredients?

audio/en/D4/D4-U10-03_t8.mp3.text: Please write your name and phone number here.

audio/en/D4/D4-U10-04_t1.mp3.text: Are you in the photography club?

audio/en/D4/D4-U10-04_t2.mp3.text: Yes, we go on photo walks every month.

audio/en/D4/D4-U10-04_t4.mp3.text: Of course. Many members are beginners.

audio/en/D4/D4-U10-04_t5.mp3.text: I only have a phone camera.

audio/en/D4/D4-U10-04_t8.mp3.text: At the flower garden on Saturday.

audio/en/D4/D4-U10-05_t1.mp3.text: How was your first club meeting?

audio/en/D4/D4-U10-05_t2.mp3.text: It was great. Everyone was very friendly.

audio/en/D4/D4-U10-05_t3.mp3.text: Did you talk to many people?

audio/en/D4/D4-U10-05_t4.mp3.text: Yes, I met someone who lives near me.

audio/en/D4/D4-U10-05_t5.mp3.text: That's nice. Are you going again?

audio/en/D4/D4-U10-05_t6.mp3.text: Definitely. I already signed up for next month.

audio/en/D4/D4-U10-05_t7.mp3.text: I'm glad you found a new hobby.

audio/en/D4/D4-U10-05_t8.mp3.text: Me too. You should come with me sometime.

audio/en/D5/D5-U01-01_t1.mp3.text: Have you decided where to go for vacation?

audio/en/D5/D5-U01-01_t10.mp3.text: That sounds wonderful. Will you recommend a hotel?

audio/en/D5/D5-U01-01_t11.mp3.text: Sure. I'll send you the link tonight.

audio/en/D5/D5-U01-01_t12.mp3.text: Thanks a lot. I'm really excited now!

audio/en/D5/D5-U01-01_t2.mp3.text: Not yet. I'm thinking about Japan or Thailand.

audio/en/D5/D5-U01-01_t3.mp3.text: Japan sounds great. Autumn is beautiful there.

audio/en/D5/D5-U01-01_t4.mp3.text: True, but flights to Thailand are cheaper.

audio/en/D5/D5-U01-01_t5.mp3.text: How long are you planning to stay?

audio/en/D5/D5-U01-01_t6.mp3.text: About five days. I can't take a longer break.

audio/en/D5/D5-U01-01_t7.mp3.text: Then Japan might be better. You can see a lot in five days.

audio/en/D5/D5-U01-01_t8.mp3.text: Good point. What should I see in Tokyo?

audio/en/D5/D5-U01-01_t9.mp3.text: Visit the old temples and try the street food.

audio/en/D5/D5-U01-02_t1.mp3.text: Do you have a minute? I need some help.

audio/en/D5/D5-U01-02_t10.mp3.text: Great. Try to keep it under ten minutes.

audio/en/D5/D5-U01-02_t11.mp3.text: Okay. Thank you so much for your time.

audio/en/D5/D5-U01-02_t12.mp3.text: Anytime. I'm sure you'll do a great job.

audio/en/D5/D5-U01-02_t3.mp3.text: I'm preparing the presentation for Friday's meeting.

audio/en/D5/D5-U01-02_t4.mp3.text: Oh, how is it going so far?

audio/en/D5/D5-U01-02_t5.mp3.text: I finished the slides, but I'm nervous about speaking.

audio/en/D5/D5-U01-02_t6.mp3.text: Don't worry. Why don't you practice in front of me?

audio/en/D5/D5-U01-02_t7.mp3.text: Really? That would be a big help.

audio/en/D5/D5-U01-02_t8.mp3.text: No problem. How about after lunch today?

audio/en/D5/D5-U01-02_t9.mp3.text: That works for me. I'll bring my laptop.

audio/en/D5/D5-U01-03_t1.mp3.text: Hi, I saw your ad for the apartment. Is it still available?

audio/en/D5/D5-U01-03_t10.mp3.text: Small pets are fine. Do you have one?

audio/en/D5/D5-U01-03_t11.mp3.text: I have a cat. When can I visit?

audio/en/D5/D5-U01-03_t12.mp3.text: How about tomorrow at four o'clock?

audio/en/D5/D5-U01-03_t2.mp3.text: Yes, it is. Would you like to see it?

audio/en/D5/D5-U01-03_t4.mp3.text: It has one bedroom and a small living room.

audio/en/D5/D5-U01-03_t5.mp3.text: How much is the monthly rent?

audio/en/D5/D5-U01-03_t6.mp3.text: It's seven hundred dollars, and utilities are not included.

audio/en/D5/D5-U01-03_t8.mp3.text: Yes, the subway station is a five-minute walk away.

audio/en/D5/D5-U01-04_t1.mp3.text: Hello. I bought these headphones last week, but one side doesn't work.

audio/en/D5/D5-U01-04_t10.mp3.text: It usually takes three to five days.

audio/en/D5/D5-U01-04_t11.mp3.text: That's fine. Thank you for your quick help.

audio/en/D5/D5-U01-04_t12.mp3.text: You're welcome. Sorry for the inconvenience.

audio/en/D5/D5-U01-04_t2.mp3.text: I'm very sorry about that. May I see them?

audio/en/D5/D5-U01-04_t3.mp3.text: Here you are. I only used them twice.

audio/en/D5/D5-U01-04_t4.mp3.text: Let me check. You're right, there's a problem with the left speaker.

audio/en/D5/D5-U01-04_t5.mp3.text: Can I get a refund, please?

audio/en/D5/D5-U01-04_t6.mp3.text: Certainly. Do you have the receipt with you?

audio/en/D5/D5-U01-04_t7.mp3.text: Yes, I have it right here.

audio/en/D5/D5-U01-04_t8.mp3.text: Thank you. The refund will go back to your card.

audio/en/D5/D5-U01-05_t1.mp3.text: Your English is getting better. How do you practice?

audio/en/D5/D5-U01-05_t10.mp3.text: A little every day is better than a long time once a week.

audio/en/D5/D5-U01-05_t2.mp3.text: Thanks! I listen to English for thirty minutes every day.

audio/en/D5/D5-U01-05_t4.mp3.text: Yes, I use an app that plays short sentences.

audio/en/D5/D5-U01-05_t5.mp3.text: Do you repeat them out loud?

audio/en/D5/D5-U01-05_t6.mp3.text: Always. Speaking out loud helps me remember.

audio/en/D5/D5-U01-05_t7.mp3.text: I'm too shy to speak. What should I do?

audio/en/D5/D5-U01-05_t8.mp3.text: Start alone at home. Nobody will hear you.

audio/en/D5/D5-U01-05_t9.mp3.text: That's a good idea. How often should I practice?

audio/en/D5/D5-U02-01_t1.mp3.text: You look worried. Is everything okay?

audio/en/D5/D5-U02-01_t10.mp3.text: That's a good idea. I can do it after work.

audio/en/D5/D5-U02-01_t11.mp3.text: And talk to people who work in marketing.

audio/en/D5/D5-U02-01_t12.mp3.text: Thanks. I feel a little clearer now.

audio/en/D5/D5-U02-01_t3.mp3.text: Really? Don't you like your job?

audio/en/D5/D5-U02-01_t4.mp3.text: It's okay, but I don't feel like I'm growing.

audio/en/D5/D5-U02-01_t5.mp3.text: What kind of job do you want to do?

audio/en/D5/D5-U02-01_t6.mp3.text: Something in marketing. I've always been interested in it.

audio/en/D5/D5-U02-01_t8.mp3.text: Not yet. I don't know where to start.

audio/en/D5/D5-U02-01_t9.mp3.text: Why don't you try an online course first?

audio/en/D5/D5-U02-02_t1.mp3.text: Mom, can I talk to you about my major?

audio/en/D5/D5-U02-02_t10.mp3.text: Yes. It's creative, and there are many jobs.

audio/en/D5/D5-U02-02_t11.mp3.text: That's true. I'll look into it.

audio/en/D5/D5-U02-02_t12.mp3.text: Whatever you choose, I'll support you.

audio/en/D5/D5-U02-02_t2.mp3.text: Of course. What's on your mind?

audio/en/D5/D5-U02-02_t3.mp3.text: I'm not sure about studying business anymore.

audio/en/D5/D5-U02-02_t4.mp3.text: Oh, I thought you liked it.

audio/en/D5/D5-U02-02_t5.mp3.text: It's fine, but I really love art.

audio/en/D5/D5-U02-02_t6.mp3.text: Do you want to change your major?

audio/en/D5/D5-U02-02_t7.mp3.text: Maybe. But I'm worried about finding a job.

audio/en/D5/D5-U02-02_t8.mp3.text: That's a fair worry. Have you thought about design?

audio/en/D5/D5-U02-03_t1.mp3.text: I got some big news today.

audio/en/D5/D5-U02-03_t10.mp3.text: How long would you stay there?

audio/en/D5/D5-U02-03_t12.mp3.text: Two years isn't forever. It could be a great experience.

audio/en/D5/D5-U02-03_t3.mp3.text: My boss offered me a promotion.

audio/en/D5/D5-U02-03_t7.mp3.text: I'd have to move to the office in Busan.

audio/en/D5/D5-U02-03_t8.mp3.text: Oh, I see. That's a big change.

audio/en/D5/D5-U02-03_t9.mp3.text: Yes. All my friends and family are here.

audio/en/D5/D5-U02-04_t1.mp3.text: Are you still thinking about graduate school?

audio/en/D5/D5-U02-04_t10.mp3.text: You're right. That's important for me.

audio/en/D5/D5-U02-04_t11.mp3.text: Why don't you visit a few schools first?

audio/en/D5/D5-U02-04_t12.mp3.text: Good idea. I'll go to an information session.

audio/en/D5/D5-U02-04_t4.mp3.text: It's expensive, and I'd have to quit my job.

audio/en/D5/D5-U02-04_t7.mp3.text: That sounds like a good option.

audio/en/D5/D5-U02-04_t8.mp3.text: But it would take three years instead of two.

audio/en/D5/D5-U02-04_t9.mp3.text: That's true, but you could keep your salary.

audio/en/D5/D5-U02-05_t1.mp3.text: Can I tell you a secret?

audio/en/D5/D5-U02-05_t10.mp3.text: Then you can see if people like it.

audio/en/D5/D5-U02-05_t11.mp3.text: And I can save money at the same time.

audio/en/D5/D5-U02-05_t12.mp3.text: Exactly. I'll be your first customer!

audio/en/D5/D5-U02-05_t3.mp3.text: I want to open my own bakery someday.

audio/en/D5/D5-U02-05_t4.mp3.text: Really? You do make great bread.

audio/en/D5/D5-U02-05_t5.mp3.text: Thanks. But I'm scared to quit my job.

audio/en/D5/D5-U02-05_t6.mp3.text: You don't have to quit right away.

audio/en/D5/D5-U02-05_t8.mp3.text: You could sell bread at weekend markets first.

audio/en/D5/D5-U03-01_t1.mp3.text: Welcome back! How was your vacation?

audio/en/D5/D5-U03-01_t10.mp3.text: It rained one day, but the rest was sunny.

audio/en/D5/D5-U03-01_t12.mp3.text: It was. I want to go back already.

audio/en/D5/D5-U03-01_t2.mp3.text: It was wonderful. I went to Jeju Island.

audio/en/D5/D5-U03-01_t3.mp3.text: Nice! What did you do there?

audio/en/D5/D5-U03-01_t4.mp3.text: I climbed Hallasan and went to the beach.

audio/en/D5/D5-U03-01_t6.mp3.text: Very! It took eight hours, but the view was amazing.

audio/en/D5/D5-U03-01_t8.mp3.text: I ate black pork every day. It was so good.

audio/en/D5/D5-U03-01_t9.mp3.text: I'm so jealous. How was the weather?

audio/en/D5/D5-U03-02_t1.mp3.text: How was your trip to the city?

audio/en/D5/D5-U03-02_t10.mp3.text: True. And I found a really good restaurant.

audio/en/D5/D5-U03-02_t12.mp3.text: You're right. The food saved the trip.

audio/en/D5/D5-U03-02_t4.mp3.text: First, our hotel was much smaller than the pictures.

audio/en/D5/D5-U03-02_t6.mp3.text: And it rained almost every day.

audio/en/D5/D5-U03-02_t9.mp3.text: Well, at least museums are indoors.

audio/en/D5/D5-U03-03_t1.mp3.text: Did you have a good time with your family?

audio/en/D5/D5-U03-03_t10.mp3.text: Yes, we grilled it for dinner.

audio/en/D5/D5-U03-03_t11.mp3.text: What a great memory for him.

audio/en/D5/D5-U03-03_t12.mp3.text: Yes. He's already asking when we can go again.

audio/en/D5/D5-U03-03_t2.mp3.text: Yes, we went camping for four days.

audio/en/D5/D5-U03-03_t3.mp3.text: Camping with kids? That sounds busy.

audio/en/D5/D5-U03-03_t4.mp3.text: It was, but they loved it.

audio/en/D5/D5-U03-03_t5.mp3.text: What did they enjoy the most?

audio/en/D5/D5-U03-03_t6.mp3.text: Fishing in the lake and making a fire.

audio/en/D5/D5-U03-03_t8.mp3.text: My son caught a big one! He was so proud.

audio/en/D5/D5-U03-03_t9.mp3.text: That's wonderful. Did you cook it?

audio/en/D5/D5-U03-04_t1.mp3.text: I heard you traveled alone. How was it?

audio/en/D5/D5-U03-04_t10.mp3.text: I could do whatever I wanted, whenever I wanted.

audio/en/D5/D5-U03-04_t12.mp3.text: It was. I recommend it to everyone.

audio/en/D5/D5-U03-04_t2.mp3.text: It was my first time, and I loved it.

audio/en/D5/D5-U03-04_t4.mp3.text: A little at dinner, but I met people at the hostel.

audio/en/D5/D5-U03-04_t7.mp3.text: Did you speak English with them?

audio/en/D5/D5-U03-04_t9.mp3.text: What was the best part of traveling alone?

audio/en/D5/D5-U03-05_t1.mp3.text: You look tired. Didn't you just come back from vacation?

audio/en/D5/D5-U03-05_t11.mp3.text: And then you can tell me about your trip.

audio/en/D5/D5-U03-05_t12.mp3.text: Deal. I have so many photos to show you.

audio/en/D5/D5-U03-05_t4.mp3.text: I can't get used to work again.

audio/en/D5/D5-U03-05_t5.mp3.text: Ha ha, I know that feeling.

audio/en/D5/D5-U03-05_t6.mp3.text: And I have two hundred emails to read.

audio/en/D5/D5-U03-05_t7.mp3.text: Oh no. Do you want some help?

audio/en/D5/D5-U03-05_t8.mp3.text: Could you tell me what happened in the meetings?

audio/en/D5/D5-U04-01_t1.mp3.text: Okay, everyone. Let's start the meeting.

audio/en/D5/D5-U04-01_t11.mp3.text: I'll do it, but I'll need everyone's help.

audio/en/D5/D5-U04-01_t12.mp3.text: Of course. Let's meet again next Monday.

audio/en/D5/D5-U04-01_t2.mp3.text: Sure. What's first on the agenda?

audio/en/D5/D5-U04-01_t3.mp3.text: We need to divide the work for the new project.

audio/en/D5/D5-U04-01_t5.mp3.text: Research, design, and the final presentation.

audio/en/D5/D5-U04-01_t6.mp3.text: I can do the research. I've done it before.

audio/en/D5/D5-U04-01_t7.mp3.text: Great. Who wants to handle the design?

audio/en/D5/D5-U04-01_t8.mp3.text: Maybe Jin? She's really good at it.

audio/en/D5/D5-U04-01_t9.mp3.text: Good idea. I'll ask her after the meeting.

audio/en/D5/D5-U04-02_t10.mp3.text: Good idea. Each of us can write one section.

audio/en/D5/D5-U04-02_t11.mp3.text: Let's share our drafts by Thursday.

audio/en/D5/D5-U04-02_t12.mp3.text: Okay. I think we can make it.

audio/en/D5/D5-U04-02_t2.mp3.text: Me too. We only have one week left.

audio/en/D5/D5-U04-02_t4.mp3.text: The research is done, but the report isn't finished.

audio/en/D5/D5-U04-02_t7.mp3.text: Should we ask for more time?

audio/en/D5/D5-U04-02_t9.mp3.text: Then let's split the report into parts.

audio/en/D5/D5-U04-03_t1.mp3.text: I don't think this design will work.

audio/en/D5/D5-U04-03_t10.mp3.text: Sure. I'll keep the layout and change the colors.

audio/en/D5/D5-U04-03_t11.mp3.text: Thanks. I'm sorry if that sounded rude.

audio/en/D5/D5-U04-03_t12.mp3.text: Not at all. Honest feedback helps.

audio/en/D5/D5-U04-03_t2.mp3.text: Why not? I spent a lot of time on it.

audio/en/D5/D5-U04-03_t3.mp3.text: I know, and it looks great.

audio/en/D5/D5-U04-03_t5.mp3.text: The colors are too dark for our customers.

audio/en/D5/D5-U04-03_t6.mp3.text: Hmm. Our customers are mostly young people, right?

audio/en/D5/D5-U04-03_t7.mp3.text: Yes. They usually like bright colors.

audio/en/D5/D5-U04-03_t9.mp3.text: Could you try a brighter version?

audio/en/D5/D5-U04-04_t1.mp3.text: Can you listen to my presentation?

audio/en/D5/D5-U04-04_t10.mp3.text: Try to look at the audience, not the screen.

audio/en/D5/D5-U04-04_t11.mp3.text: Good point. I'll practice again tonight.

audio/en/D5/D5-U04-04_t3.mp3.text: Good morning, everyone. Today, I'll talk about our new app.

audio/en/D5/D5-U04-04_t5.mp3.text: Our app helps people save money every day.

audio/en/D5/D5-U04-04_t6.mp3.text: Can you speak a little slower?

audio/en/D5/D5-U04-04_t7.mp3.text: Oh, sorry. I always speak fast when I'm nervous.

audio/en/D5/D5-U04-04_t8.mp3.text: That's normal. Take a breath between slides.

audio/en/D5/D5-U04-05_t10.mp3.text: Sounds perfect. Should I book a place?

audio/en/D5/D5-U04-05_t2.mp3.text: I can't believe it. It was a long two months.

audio/en/D5/D5-U04-05_t3.mp3.text: The client said they loved our presentation.

audio/en/D5/D5-U04-05_t5.mp3.text: Yes. They want to work with us again.

audio/en/D5/D5-U04-05_t6.mp3.text: All our hard work paid off.

audio/en/D5/D5-U04-05_t7.mp3.text: Thank you for staying late so many nights.

audio/en/D5/D5-U04-05_t8.mp3.text: We all did. It was a real team effort.

audio/en/D5/D5-U05-01_t10.mp3.text: I can book you on the next flight tomorrow morning.

audio/en/D5/D5-U05-01_t11.mp3.text: Will you give me a hotel for tonight?

audio/en/D5/D5-U05-01_t12.mp3.text: Yes, the hotel and meals are included.

audio/en/D5/D5-U05-01_t2.mp3.text: Yes, I'm afraid it's delayed by three hours.

audio/en/D5/D5-U05-01_t4.mp3.text: There's a problem with the weather in Tokyo.

audio/en/D5/D5-U05-01_t5.mp3.text: I have a connecting flight in Tokyo.

audio/en/D5/D5-U05-01_t8.mp3.text: I'm sorry, but you'll miss that connection.

audio/en/D5/D5-U05-01_t9.mp3.text: Oh no. What should I do?

audio/en/D5/D5-U05-02_t1.mp3.text: Excuse me. My suitcase didn't come out.

audio/en/D5/D5-U05-02_t10.mp3.text: It should be on tomorrow's flight.

audio/en/D5/D5-U05-02_t11.mp3.text: Can you send it to my hotel?

audio/en/D5/D5-U05-02_t12.mp3.text: Of course. Please write down the address here.

audio/en/D5/D5-U05-02_t2.mp3.text: I'm sorry. Can I see your baggage tag?

audio/en/D5/D5-U05-02_t5.mp3.text: It's a large red suitcase with a black handle.

audio/en/D5/D5-U05-02_t8.mp3.text: It looks like it's still in Hong Kong.

audio/en/D5/D5-U05-02_t9.mp3.text: Oh no! When will it arrive?

audio/en/D5/D5-U05-03_t1.mp3.text: Excuse me. Can I change my seat?

audio/en/D5/D5-U05-03_t12.mp3.text: Please call me if you need anything else.

audio/en/D5/D5-U05-03_t2.mp3.text: Is there a problem with your seat?

audio/en/D5/D5-U05-03_t3.mp3.text: I'm in the middle, and I'm not feeling well.

audio/en/D5/D5-U05-03_t4.mp3.text: I'm sorry to hear that. Would an aisle seat help?

audio/en/D5/D5-U05-03_t5.mp3.text: Yes, that would be much better.

audio/en/D5/D5-U05-03_t6.mp3.text: Let me check. There's one in row twenty.

audio/en/D5/D5-U05-03_t8.mp3.text: Do you need some water or medicine?

audio/en/D5/D5-U05-04_t1.mp3.text: Oh no. I think I left my passport at the hotel.

audio/en/D5/D5-U05-04_t10.mp3.text: Yes, ask them to keep it at the front desk.

audio/en/D5/D5-U05-04_t11.mp3.text: Okay. I'll take a taxi right away.

audio/en/D5/D5-U05-04_t12.mp3.text: I'll wait here with our bags. Hurry!

audio/en/D5/D5-U05-04_t2.mp3.text: What? Are you sure? Check your bag again.

audio/en/D5/D5-U05-04_t3.mp3.text: I checked twice. It's not here.

audio/en/D5/D5-U05-04_t4.mp3.text: Okay, don't panic. What time is our flight?

audio/en/D5/D5-U05-04_t5.mp3.text: In two and a half hours.

audio/en/D5/D5-U05-04_t6.mp3.text: How far is the hotel from here?

audio/en/D5/D5-U05-04_t8.mp3.text: Then you can still make it if you go now.

audio/en/D5/D5-U05-04_t9.mp3.text: Should I call the hotel first?

audio/en/D5/D5-U05-05_t1.mp3.text: Good afternoon. Can I see your passport, please?

audio/en/D5/D5-U05-05_t10.mp3.text: Yes, it is. I'm very excited.

audio/en/D5/D5-U05-05_t3.mp3.text: What's the purpose of your visit?

audio/en/D5/D5-U05-05_t8.mp3.text: At a hotel downtown. Here's the booking.

audio/en/D5/D5-U05-05_t9.mp3.text: Is this your first time here?

audio/en/D5/D5-U06-01_t10.mp3.text: Really? Coffee helps me stay awake at work.

audio/en/D5/D5-U06-01_t11.mp3.text: Try stopping after lunch for a week.

audio/en/D5/D5-U06-01_t12.mp3.text: Okay, I'll give it a try.

audio/en/D5/D5-U06-01_t2.mp3.text: I can't sleep well these days.

audio/en/D5/D5-U06-01_t4.mp3.text: About two weeks. I keep waking up at night.

audio/en/D5/D5-U06-01_t6.mp3.text: Maybe. Work has been really busy.

audio/en/D5/D5-U06-01_t7.mp3.text: Do you drink coffee in the afternoon?

audio/en/D5/D5-U06-02_t1.mp3.text: Are you okay? You keep touching your back.

audio/en/D5/D5-U06-02_t10.mp3.text: Do you know a good clinic?

audio/en/D5/D5-U06-02_t11.mp3.text: Yes, I'll send you the name.

audio/en/D5/D5-U06-02_t2.mp3.text: My lower back hurts these days.

audio/en/D5/D5-U06-02_t4.mp3.text: No, I think it's from sitting all day.

audio/en/D5/D5-U06-02_t7.mp3.text: You should stand up and stretch every hour.

audio/en/D5/D5-U06-02_t9.mp3.text: It helps. But if it gets worse, see a doctor.

audio/en/D5/D5-U06-03_t1.mp3.text: I want to lose some weight before summer.

audio/en/D5/D5-U06-03_t10.mp3.text: Start by walking thirty minutes a day.

audio/en/D5/D5-U06-03_t12.mp3.text: Small changes are easier to keep.

audio/en/D5/D5-U06-03_t2.mp3.text: How are you planning to do it?

audio/en/D5/D5-U06-03_t4.mp3.text: Hmm, I don't think that's a good idea.

audio/en/D5/D5-U06-03_t6.mp3.text: You'll be too hungry and eat more later.

audio/en/D5/D5-U06-03_t8.mp3.text: Eat smaller meals and more vegetables.

audio/en/D5/D5-U06-04_t1.mp3.text: You've seemed down lately. What's going on?

audio/en/D5/D5-U06-04_t10.mp3.text: Thanks. You always know how to cheer me up.

audio/en/D5/D5-U06-04_t12.mp3.text: I'm really lucky to have you.

audio/en/D5/D5-U06-04_t3.mp3.text: Is it work or something personal?

audio/en/D5/D5-U06-04_t4.mp3.text: Both, I guess. Everything feels like too much.

audio/en/D5/D5-U06-04_t5.mp3.text: I'm sorry. Do you want to talk about it?

audio/en/D5/D5-U06-04_t6.mp3.text: Maybe later. I just need a break.

audio/en/D5/D5-U06-04_t7.mp3.text: How about a walk in the park after work?

audio/en/D5/D5-U06-04_t9.mp3.text: And let's get some good food after.

audio/en/D5/D5-U06-05_t1.mp3.text: Did you get the results of your checkup?

audio/en/D5/D5-U06-05_t10.mp3.text: That would help. It's easier with a friend.

audio/en/D5/D5-U06-05_t4.mp3.text: Mostly. But my blood pressure is a little high.

audio/en/D5/D5-U06-05_t5.mp3.text: Oh. What did the doctor say?

audio/en/D5/D5-U06-05_t6.mp3.text: I need to eat less salt and exercise more.

audio/en/D5/D5-U06-05_t7.mp3.text: That's not too bad. You can change that.

audio/en/D5/D5-U06-05_t8.mp3.text: Yes, but I love salty food.

audio/en/D5/D5-U06-05_t9.mp3.text: Me too. Let's try to eat healthier together.

audio/en/D5/D5-U07-01_t10.mp3.text: I'll also buy some soft slippers.

audio/en/D5/D5-U07-01_t12.mp3.text: Please tell me if it happens again.

audio/en/D5/D5-U07-01_t3.mp3.text: I'm sorry to bother you, but it's been noisy at night.

audio/en/D5/D5-U07-01_t5.mp3.text: I hear footsteps and furniture moving after midnight.

audio/en/D5/D5-U07-01_t6.mp3.text: I'm so sorry. I work late, so I clean at night.

audio/en/D5/D5-U07-01_t7.mp3.text: I understand, but I have to get up early.

audio/en/D5/D5-U07-01_t8.mp3.text: Of course. I'll try to finish before eleven.

audio/en/D5/D5-U07-01_t9.mp3.text: Thank you. That would really help.

audio/en/D5/D5-U07-02_t1.mp3.text: Excuse me. Is this your car?

audio/en/D5/D5-U07-02_t10.mp3.text: Oh, I didn't know that. Thanks for telling me.

audio/en/D5/D5-U07-02_t11.mp3.text: No problem. Have a nice day.

audio/en/D5/D5-U07-02_t2.mp3.text: Yes, it is. Is there a problem?

audio/en/D5/D5-U07-02_t3.mp3.text: It's blocking my garage. I can't get my car out.

audio/en/D5/D5-U07-02_t4.mp3.text: Oh, I'm so sorry. I didn't see the sign.

audio/en/D5/D5-U07-02_t5.mp3.text: It's okay. I'm just in a hurry.

audio/en/D5/D5-U07-02_t7.mp3.text: Thank you. Are you visiting someone here?

audio/en/D5/D5-U07-02_t8.mp3.text: Yes, my friend lives in this building.

audio/en/D5/D5-U07-02_t9.mp3.text: There's a visitor parking lot behind the building.

audio/en/D5/D5-U07-03_t1.mp3.text: Hi. Do you have a minute?

audio/en/D5/D5-U07-03_t10.mp3.text: Sure. I'll go to the smoking area outside.

audio/en/D5/D5-U07-03_t11.mp3.text: Thank you so much for understanding.

audio/en/D5/D5-U07-03_t12.mp3.text: No problem. I should have thought of it.

audio/en/D5/D5-U07-03_t3.mp3.text: I smell cigarette smoke in my apartment every evening.

audio/en/D5/D5-U07-03_t4.mp3.text: Oh, I sometimes smoke on my balcony.

audio/en/D5/D5-U07-03_t5.mp3.text: I think the smoke comes into my window.

audio/en/D5/D5-U07-03_t6.mp3.text: I'm sorry. I didn't realize that.

audio/en/D5/D5-U07-03_t7.mp3.text: My baby is very young, so I'm worried.

audio/en/D5/D5-U07-04_t1.mp3.text: Excuse me. Do you have a dog?

audio/en/D5/D5-U07-04_t10.mp3.text: I'll also leave him some toys.

audio/en/D5/D5-U07-04_t11.mp3.text: Thanks. I hope it helps him, too.

audio/en/D5/D5-U07-04_t2.mp3.text: Yes, I do. Why do you ask?

audio/en/D5/D5-U07-04_t3.mp3.text: It barks a lot during the day.

audio/en/D5/D5-U07-04_t4.mp3.text: Really? I'm at work during the day.

audio/en/D5/D5-U07-04_t5.mp3.text: I work from home, so I hear it all the time.

audio/en/D5/D5-U07-04_t6.mp3.text: I'm sorry. He must be lonely when I'm gone.

audio/en/D5/D5-U07-04_t8.mp3.text: I'll ask a dog walker to come at lunch.

audio/en/D5/D5-U07-05_t1.mp3.text: Did you see the hallway? It's really messy.

audio/en/D5/D5-U07-05_t10.mp3.text: Thanks. Let me know if it doesn't work.

audio/en/D5/D5-U07-05_t11.mp3.text: Then we'll talk to the manager together.

audio/en/D5/D5-U07-05_t3.mp3.text: Should we tell the building manager?

audio/en/D5/D5-U07-05_t4.mp3.text: Maybe we should leave a note first.

audio/en/D5/D5-U07-05_t5.mp3.text: Good idea. What should we write?

audio/en/D5/D5-U07-05_t6.mp3.text: Something polite, like, "Please keep the hallway clean."

audio/en/D5/D5-U07-05_t7.mp3.text: And we can add the recycling day.

audio/en/D5/D5-U07-05_t8.mp3.text: Yes, maybe they don't know about it.

audio/en/D5/D5-U07-05_t9.mp3.text: I'll write it tonight and put it up.

audio/en/D5/D5-U08-01_t1.mp3.text: Hi, are you selling a bicycle?

audio/en/D5/D5-U08-01_t10.mp3.text: I'm asking for one hundred dollars. How about ninety?

audio/en/D5/D5-U08-01_t11.mp3.text: Deal. Can I pay by bank transfer?

audio/en/D5/D5-U08-01_t4.mp3.text: About two years, but I didn't ride it much.

audio/en/D5/D5-U08-01_t5.mp3.text: Is there anything wrong with it?

audio/en/D5/D5-U08-01_t6.mp3.text: No, it works perfectly. I just changed the tires.

audio/en/D5/D5-U08-01_t9.mp3.text: It's really nice. Can you lower the price a little?

audio/en/D5/D5-U08-02_t1.mp3.text: Hi, I'm here for the desk.

audio/en/D5/D5-U08-02_t10.mp3.text: I'll help you carry it to your car.

audio/en/D5/D5-U08-02_t11.mp3.text: Thanks. It's heavier than I thought.

audio/en/D5/D5-U08-02_t12.mp3.text: It's solid wood. It'll last a long time.

audio/en/D5/D5-U08-02_t3.mp3.text: Hmm, it looks different from the photo.

audio/en/D5/D5-U08-02_t5.mp3.text: There's a big scratch on the top.

audio/en/D5/D5-U08-02_t6.mp3.text: Oh, I'm sorry. I forgot to mention that.

audio/en/D5/D5-U08-02_t7.mp3.text: I'm not sure I still want it at that price.

audio/en/D5/D5-U08-02_t8.mp3.text: I understand. How about twenty dollars less?

audio/en/D5/D5-U08-03_t1.mp3.text: I want to sell some clothes I don't wear.

audio/en/D5/D5-U08-03_t10.mp3.text: Yes, but always meet in a public place.

audio/en/D5/D5-U08-03_t11.mp3.text: Thanks. I'll try it this weekend.

audio/en/D5/D5-U08-03_t12.mp3.text: Good luck! Maybe you'll make some money.

audio/en/D5/D5-U08-03_t2.mp3.text: You should try the second-hand app.

audio/en/D5/D5-U08-03_t4.mp3.text: Very. Just take photos and write a description.

audio/en/D5/D5-U08-03_t5.mp3.text: How much should I ask for?

audio/en/D5/D5-U08-03_t6.mp3.text: Check what similar items sell for.

audio/en/D5/D5-U08-03_t7.mp3.text: Good idea. What kind of photos sell best?

audio/en/D5/D5-U08-03_t8.mp3.text: Bright photos with a plain background.

audio/en/D5/D5-U08-03_t9.mp3.text: Should I meet buyers in person?

audio/en/D5/D5-U08-04_t1.mp3.text: Hello, I saw your ad for the camera.

audio/en/D5/D5-U08-04_t10.mp3.text: That's too low. How about two hundred and eighty?

audio/en/D5/D5-U08-04_t11.mp3.text: Okay, it's a deal. When can we meet?

audio/en/D5/D5-U08-04_t12.mp3.text: How about tomorrow at the subway station?

audio/en/D5/D5-U08-04_t4.mp3.text: I bought a new one, so I don't need this anymore.

audio/en/D5/D5-U08-04_t5.mp3.text: Does it come with the lens?

audio/en/D5/D5-U08-04_t6.mp3.text: Yes, and a bag and an extra battery.

audio/en/D5/D5-U08-04_t7.mp3.text: The price is three hundred dollars, right?

audio/en/D5/D5-U08-04_t9.mp3.text: Could you do two hundred and fifty?

audio/en/D5/D5-U08-05_t1.mp3.text: Are you still giving away the bookshelf?

audio/en/D5/D5-U08-05_t11.mp3.text: Thank you so much. Can I give you something?

audio/en/D5/D5-U08-05_t3.mp3.text: That's great. Why are you giving it away?

audio/en/D5/D5-U08-05_t5.mp3.text: Oh, exciting! Where are you going?

audio/en/D5/D5-U08-05_t7.mp3.text: Wow. Good luck with the move.

audio/en/D5/D5-U08-05_t8.mp3.text: Thanks. Do you have a car?

audio/en/D5/D5-U09-01_t1.mp3.text: I want to start a new hobby. Any ideas?

audio/en/D5/D5-U09-01_t10.mp3.text: Twice a week. You can come with me on Thursday.

audio/en/D5/D5-U09-01_t12.mp3.text: I'll pick you up after work.

audio/en/D5/D5-U09-01_t2.mp3.text: What kind of things do you like?

audio/en/D5/D5-U09-01_t3.mp3.text: Something active. I sit all day at work.

audio/en/D5/D5-U09-01_t6.mp3.text: Not at an indoor gym. They teach you everything.

audio/en/D5/D5-U09-02_t1.mp3.text: I'm bored at home on weekends.

audio/en/D5/D5-U09-02_t11.mp3.text: Okay, I'll buy some yarn this weekend.

audio/en/D5/D5-U09-02_t12.mp3.text: Send me a picture when you finish!

audio/en/D5/D5-U09-02_t2.mp3.text: Why don't you try something creative?

audio/en/D5/D5-U09-02_t5.mp3.text: I've never tried knitting. Is it hard?

audio/en/D5/D5-U09-02_t6.mp3.text: It's easy to start. There are many online videos.

audio/en/D5/D5-U09-02_t8.mp3.text: A simple scarf is a good first project.

audio/en/D5/D5-U09-03_t1.mp3.text: I've always wanted to learn an instrument.

audio/en/D5/D5-U09-03_t10.mp3.text: My cousin teaches guitar. I'll give you her number.

audio/en/D5/D5-U09-03_t12.mp3.text: Maybe you can play for me someday.

audio/en/D5/D5-U09-03_t3.mp3.text: Maybe the guitar or the piano.

audio/en/D5/D5-U09-03_t4.mp3.text: The guitar is easier to carry around.

audio/en/D5/D5-U09-03_t5.mp3.text: That's true. But isn't it hard on your fingers?

audio/en/D5/D5-U09-03_t6.mp3.text: At first, yes. But you get used to it.

audio/en/D5/D5-U09-03_t7.mp3.text: Should I take lessons or learn online?

audio/en/D5/D5-U09-03_t8.mp3.text: Take a few lessons first to learn the basics.

audio/en/D5/D5-U09-03_t9.mp3.text: Do you know a good teacher?

audio/en/D5/D5-U09-04_t1.mp3.text: My husband and I want a hobby we can do together.

audio/en/D5/D5-U09-04_t10.mp3.text: You can cook dishes from places you want to visit.

audio/en/D5/D5-U09-04_t11.mp3.text: I love that idea. Can you send me the link?

audio/en/D5/D5-U09-04_t12.mp3.text: Sure. I'll send it right now.

audio/en/D5/D5-U09-04_t2.mp3.text: That's sweet. What do you both enjoy?

audio/en/D5/D5-U09-04_t3.mp3.text: We both like food and traveling.

audio/en/D5/D5-U09-04_t4.mp3.text: How about a cooking class for couples?

audio/en/D5/D5-U09-04_t5.mp3.text: Oh, I didn't know there were classes like that.

audio/en/D5/D5-U09-04_t6.mp3.text: Yes, there's one near my office.

audio/en/D5/D5-U09-04_t7.mp3.text: What kind of food do they teach?

audio/en/D5/D5-U09-05_t1.mp3.text: I'm thinking about starting a blog.

audio/en/D5/D5-U09-05_t10.mp3.text: That's a good plan. Don't try to do too much.

audio/en/D5/D5-U09-05_t11.mp3.text: Will you read my first post?

audio/en/D5/D5-U09-05_t12.mp3.text: Of course! I'll be your first reader.

audio/en/D5/D5-U09-05_t2.mp3.text: That's cool. What would you write about?

audio/en/D5/D5-U09-05_t3.mp3.text: My travels and the food I try.

audio/en/D5/D5-U09-05_t5.mp3.text: Thanks. But I'm not sure anyone will read it.

audio/en/D5/D5-U09-05_t6.mp3.text: Write for yourself first. Readers will come later.

audio/en/D5/D5-U09-05_t7.mp3.text: That's a good way to think about it.

audio/en/D5/D5-U10-01_t10.mp3.text: Tell her we're having a simple dinner at my place.

audio/en/D5/D5-U10-01_t11.mp3.text: Ha ha, she'll be so surprised.

audio/en/D5/D5-U10-01_t12.mp3.text: Just don't tell anyone who might tell her!

audio/en/D5/D5-U10-01_t2.mp3.text: Let's throw her a surprise party!

audio/en/D5/D5-U10-01_t3.mp3.text: Great idea. Where should we have it?

audio/en/D5/D5-U10-01_t4.mp3.text: How about my apartment? It's big enough.

audio/en/D5/D5-U10-01_t6.mp3.text: Her close friends and her sister.

audio/en/D5/D5-U10-01_t7.mp3.text: I'll make the guest list and send invitations.

audio/en/D5/D5-U10-01_t9.mp3.text: How will we get her to come without telling her?

audio/en/D5/D5-U10-02_t1.mp3.text: We need to plan the year-end party.

audio/en/D5/D5-U10-02_t10.mp3.text: Let's do a lucky draw. Everyone loves that.

audio/en/D5/D5-U10-02_t11.mp3.text: Good idea. I'll ask the boss for a budget.

audio/en/D5/D5-U10-02_t12.mp3.text: And I'll call the restaurant today.

audio/en/D5/D5-U10-02_t5.mp3.text: Yes, somewhere with a private room.

audio/en/D5/D5-U10-02_t6.mp3.text: I know a good Korean barbecue place.

audio/en/D5/D5-U10-02_t8.mp3.text: Yes, they have a big room upstairs.

audio/en/D5/D5-U10-02_t9.mp3.text: Great. What about games or prizes?

audio/en/D5/D5-U10-03_t10.mp3.text: Thanks. And I have another question for you.

audio/en/D5/D5-U10-03_t12.mp3.text: Will you give a speech at my wedding?

audio/en/D5/D5-U10-03_t2.mp3.text: It's so busy. There's so much to do.

audio/en/D5/D5-U10-03_t3.mp3.text: Did you find a place yet?

audio/en/D5/D5-U10-03_t4.mp3.text: Yes, a small garden near the river.

audio/en/D5/D5-U10-03_t5.mp3.text: That sounds beautiful. What about the dress?

audio/en/D5/D5-U10-03_t6.mp3.text: I'm trying some on this weekend.

audio/en/D5/D5-U10-03_t7.mp3.text: Do you want me to come with you?

audio/en/D5/D5-U10-03_t8.mp3.text: Would you? I really want your opinion.

audio/en/D5/D5-U10-04_t1.mp3.text: The school festival is in two weeks.

audio/en/D5/D5-U10-04_t10.mp3.text: And we need people to scare the visitors.

audio/en/D5/D5-U10-04_t11.mp3.text: I'll do that. I'm good at screaming.

audio/en/D5/D5-U10-04_t12.mp3.text: Ha ha! Let's tell the class tomorrow.

audio/en/D5/D5-U10-04_t2.mp3.text: What should our class do this year?

audio/en/D5/D5-U10-04_t4.mp3.text: We did that last year. Let's try something new.

audio/en/D5/D5-U10-04_t6.mp3.text: Oh, that sounds fun! But it's a lot of work.

audio/en/D5/D5-U10-04_t7.mp3.text: If everyone helps, we can do it.

audio/en/D5/D5-U10-04_t8.mp3.text: True. Who will make the decorations?

audio/en/D5/D5-U10-04_t9.mp3.text: The art club members can help.

audio/en/D5/D5-U10-05_t1.mp3.text: Our company is having a charity run next month.

audio/en/D5/D5-U10-05_t10.mp3.text: Does all the money go to the hospital?

audio/en/D5/D5-U10-05_t3.mp3.text: To raise money for a children's hospital.

audio/en/D5/D5-U10-05_t5.mp3.text: Five kilometers. You can walk, too.

audio/en/D5/D5-U10-05_t6.mp3.text: Can people from outside the company join?

audio/en/D5/D5-U10-05_t8.mp3.text: Then I'll join with my family.

audio/en/D5/D5-U10-05_t9.mp3.text: Great! It costs twenty dollars per person.

audio/en/S2/S2-U06-03.mp3.text: I go to work by bus.

audio/en/S2/S2-U09-02.mp3.text: Do you have a smaller size?

audio/en/S2/S2-U09-04.mp3.text: Do you have it in black?
